bibliographic-data.invention-title: COMPOSÉ DE CHARGE ET UTILISATION D'UN COMPOSÉ DE CHARGE
A FILLER COMPOUND AND USE OF A FILLER COMPOUND

abstract.p: According to the present invention, there is provided a filler compound, the filler compound comprising filler particles and a binder, wherein the filler particles comprise particles of at least one glassy material, and the particles of glassy material are at least 10 wt.% of the dry mass of the filler compound, and wherein at least 30 wt.% of the filler particles have a diameter between 50 and 100 microns inclusive. Use of a filler compound in the erection of a structure is also described.
